question: Which east-flowing river basin covers the states of Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Orissa and has a Drainage area of 39,033 sq km?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Brahmani sub-basin** spans an area of **39,033 square kilometers** and exhibits a long, sausage-like shape.
 
• The **Baitarni sub-basin **covers an area of **12,789 square kilometers** and is roughly circular in shape.
 
• Originating near **Nagri village in Ranchi district of Jharkhand** at an elevation of approximately 600 meters, the Brahmani River, also known as **South Koel in its upper reaches**, is a significant seasonal river in the eastern Indian state of Odisha.
 
• The Brahmani is formed by the merging of the** Sankh and South Koel rivers **and traverses through various districts including Sundargarh, Deogarh, Angul, Dhenkanal, Cuttack, Jajapur, and Kendrapara.
 
• South Koel serves as the upper reaches of the Brahmani. Along with the river Baitarani, the Brahmani forms a substantial delta before eventually discharging into the Bay of Bengal at Dhamra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Baitarani River** holds a significant position among the six major rivers of Odisha, India. Revered in popular epics and folklore, the Baitarani River serves as a vital water source for agricultural irrigation in the region.
 
• **The River Nagavali,** also referred to as Langulya, stands as one of the primary rivers in Southern Odisha and Andhra Pradesh states in India. It is situated between the Rushikulya and Godavari basins, contributing to the socio-economic landscape of the area.
 
• **The Sarada River** finds its source in the Ananthagiri hills nestled within the Eastern Ghats of Andhra Pradesh, India.
